Formula K(d_k) = 2 * cumulative * networkLength / (count * count) for count >= 2 snapped events, else 0. cumulative is the number of unordered event pairs whose network distance is strictly below the band threshold d_k = maximumDistance * k / (bandCount - 1) (a prefix sum of the per-band pair histogram); networkLength is the length of every road counted once. The denominator is count squared (the spaghetti GlobalAutoK normalisation), not count * (count - 1). With zero simulations only the observed row exists.
